transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’ve been tapped for something huge at work and in town, like I’m the only one who really understands what’s going on and everyone else just needs to catch up to me. I'm mainly here because my wife and my team at work are struggling to keep up with my level of understanding, and they wanted me to get checked out.
Have you also had periods of very high energy or little need for sleep, or do you feel these beliefs have been present on their own without any mood changes?

Yes, I definitely have those supercharged periods where I feel incredibly energized and only sleep two or three hours a night. But even when my mood is completely flat and I'm just going through the motions, those beliefs and the metallic voice I hear are still right there with me.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least 2 weeks when the unusual beliefs or the voice were still present even though you did not have any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yes, definitely. There are stretches of a few weeks or more where my mood feels completely flat—neither high nor low—but I still hear that metallic voice at night. Even during those times, I still quietly believe that certain executives are secretly monitoring me.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voice or the belief that executives were monitoring you continued even though you had no manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yes, absolutely. There have been several times lasting two weeks or more where my mood was completely flat, with no highs or lows. Even during those quiet stretches, I still heard that metallic voice at night and believed the executives were watching me.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voice or the belief that executives were monitoring you continued even though you had no manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yes, absolutely, there are stretches of two or three weeks at a time where my mood is completely flat and I don't feel high or low at all. Yet, even during those quiet periods, I still hear that metallic voice at night and know the executives are monitoring me. It's like those things don't go away just because my mood settles down.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voice or the belief that executives were monitoring you continued even though you had no manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yes, that's correct. There are definitely periods of two weeks or more where my mood is completely flat and stable, with no highs or lows. Even during those times, I still hear that metallic voice at night and feel certain the executives are monitoring me.
Have you ever had a clear manic or depressed episode that lasted for most of at least 2 weeks, separate from the times when you were hearing the voice or feeling monitored?

Yes, early on I had long stretches of being highly energized and barely sleeping without hearing any voices or feeling watched. Those revved-up phases started about two years ago when the migration project began, whereas the metallic voice and feeling monitored didn't show up until about a year and a half later. The depressed periods are much more recent, over the last seven months, and those have mostly overlapped with the voice.
Have the voice or the belief that you were being monitored ever continued for at least 2 weeks when you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yes, definitely. There are times lasting two weeks or more where my mood is completely flat and neutral, with no highs or lows at all. Yet, during those exact periods, I still hear that metallic voice at night and feel certain the executives are monitoring me.
Have you ever had a full manic episode and a full major depressive episode, each lasting most of at least 2 weeks, in addition to the times when you heard the voice or felt monitored?

Yes, I've had highly energized 'up' phases where I barely sleep that last for weeks or months at a time, cycling over the last year and a half. I've also had heavy, hopeless 'down' phases that last for weeks at a stretch over the past seven months. But even during the times in between when my mood is completely flat and neutral, I still hear that metallic voice and feel monitored.
Have you ever had periods when the voice or the belief that you were being monitored were your only symptoms, without any other unusual experiences like disorganized speech or behavior?

Yes, during those flat periods, my speech and behavior are usually pretty normal and I just quietly go through the motions. The voice and the feeling of being watched are really the only things going on during those times.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you had hallucinations or paranoid beliefs but no manic symptoms and no depressed symptoms at all?

Yes, absolutely. There are stretches of two weeks or more where my mood is completely flat and neutral, with no highs or lows. Even during those times, I still hear that metallic voice at night and believe the executives are secretly monitoring me.
Have the hallucinations or beliefs ever started before the mood episodes, or do they only happen during mood episodes?

The highly energized mood episodes actually started first, about a year before I ever heard the voice or felt monitored. But they don't only happen during those mood swings; they also continue during the times when my mood is completely flat and normal.
Outside of the mood episodes and the voice/beliefs, have you noticed a lasting decline in your work, self-care, motivation, or social functioning for at least 6 months?

Yes, unfortunately, there has been a significant decline for over two years now; I've been written up at work and had key parts of my project taken away. I've also had to pull back from youth coaching and church leadership, and my wife has had to take over our bills and parenting because she doesn't trust my judgment anymore.

Have your mood episodes ever lasted for most of at least 2 weeks at a time, with clear mania or depression, or do the voice and monitoring beliefs continue for long periods even when your mood is otherwise normal?

Yes, both of those scenarios happen. My high, energetic phases and my low, hopeless phases definitely last for weeks or months at a time. But even during the periods when my mood feels relatively flat or normal, I still hear that metallic voice at night and believe the executives are monitoring me.

Have you ever had a full manic or depressed episode that lasted most of at least 2 weeks, and did the voice or monitoring beliefs also continue for at least 2 weeks when you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

Yes, both of those things have happened. My high-energy phases and my heavy, hopeless phases definitely last for weeks or even months at a time. And even during the flat, neutral periods when I don't feel high or low, the voice and the feeling of being monitored have easily lasted for two weeks or more.

Have your mood episodes ever been present for most of the time since the hallucinations or paranoid beliefs began, or have the psychotic symptoms clearly occurred for at least 2 weeks when your mood was completely normal?

Looking back over the last couple of years, those wired, high-energy phases have definitely taken up the vast majority of the time. At the same time, there have clearly been periods of several weeks where my mood was completely flat and normal, yet I still heard the metallic voice and believed I was being monitored.

Yes, they definitely do. Even when my mood has completely leveled out and I'm just flatly going through the motions at work, those things don't stop. I will still hear that metallic voice at night and believe the executives are monitoring me for weeks at a time.
